name: Dunedin City Council
story: Dunedin City Council’s City Consultants GIS analysts prepared mapping for the 1998 Lifelines Project. By August 2005, its public ArcIMS WebMap linked property maps to rating information. These projects served infrastructure assessment and public property enquiries respectively.
